title: Revalidate restored calibration drafts
description: Restore persisted calibration drafts through current schemas and invariants, explicitly invalidating stale layout, setup, loading, or print-configuration assumptions before continuation.
acceptanceCriteria: Restoration parses and migrates supported draft versions before use
Every immutable reference and fingerprint is resolved against current durable records
Missing, changed, or incompatible assumptions produce structured invalidation reasons before continuation
Invalid restoration preserves the stored draft for review and performs no workflow effect

steps.details: Parse a stored draft, run supported migrations, and retain source-version and migration diagnostics.
Resolve layout revision, fingerprint, setup, loading revision, and configuration revision without silently substituting newer records.
Produce resumable or invalidated results with stable reasons and corrective actions while preserving the original record.
Cover supported migration, missing records, changed fingerprints, incompatible revisions, malformed input, and no-effect refusal.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; limit work to restoration validation and fixtures.
Never reinterpret stale assumptions as current operator confirmation.
